mapper.select: select database()
select last_insert_id()
select id,phase,cutover_epoch as cutoverEpoch,drain_epoch as drainEpoch,status from family_wallet_migration_batches where id=#{batchId} for update

select scope_key as scopeKey,maintenance_enabled as maintenanceEnabled,cutover_epoch as cutoverEpoch, drain_epoch as drainEpoch,active_batch_id as activeBatchId,state,updated_by as updatedBy from family_wallet_cutover_state where scope_key='GLOBAL' for update
select count(*) from application_instance_leases where lease_expires_at > now() and lease_owner='web'
select coalesce(max(drain_epoch),0)+1 from family_wallet_cutover_state
mapper.update: update family_wallet_cutover_state set maintenance_enabled=1,drain_epoch=#{epoch},active_batch_id=#{batchId},state='QUIESCING',updated_by=#{owner} where scope_key='GLOBAL'
update family_wallet_migration_batches set phase='QUIESCE',status='QUIESCING',drain_epoch=#{epoch} where id=#{batchId}
update family_wallet_cutover_state set state='DRAINED' where scope_key='GLOBAL' and active_batch_id=#{batchId} and drain_epoch=#{epoch}
update family_wallet_migration_batches set phase='QUIESCE',status='DRAINED',drain_epoch=#{epoch} where id=#{batchId}
update family_wallet_cutover_state set maintenance_enabled=0,active_batch_id=null,state='COMPATIBLE',updated_by=null where scope_key='GLOBAL'
mapper.select: select count(*) from family_wallet_migration_sources where batch_id=#{batchId}
select count(*) from family_cart_migration_sources where batch_id=#{batchId}
select count(*) from family_wallet_migration_anomalies where batch_id=#{batchId} and anomaly_type like 'DDL_%'
mapper.update: update family_wallet_migration_batches set status='ABORTED',completed_at=now() where id=#{batchId}
mapper.insert: insert into family_wallet_migration_anomalies(batch_id,anomaly_type,source_type,source_id,detail_json) select #{batchId}, anomaly_type,source_type,source_id,detail_json from ( select 'WALLET_NO_ACTIVE_FAMILY' anomaly_type,'USER' source_type,mw.user_id source_id, json_object('userId',mw.user_id) detail_json from member_wallets mw left join family_user_relations fur on fur.user_id=mw.user_id and fur.status='ACTIVE' where fur.family_id is null and (mw.balance_amount<>0 or mw.frozen_amount<>0) union all select 'WALLET_INACTIVE_FAMILY','USER',mw.user_id, json_object('userId',mw.user_id,'familyId',fur.family_id) from member_wallets mw join family_user_relations fur on fur.user_id=mw.user_id and fur.status='ACTIVE' left join families f on f.id=fur.family_id and f.status='active' where f.id is null and (mw.balance_amount<>0 or mw.frozen_amount<>0) union all select 'WALLET_MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_FAMILIES','USER',fur.user_id,json_object('userId',fur.user_id,'families',count(*)) from family_user_relations fur where fur.status='ACTIVE' group by fur.user_id having count(*)>1 union all select 'CART_DISH_UNAVAILABLE','CART',c.id,json_object('cartId',c.id,'dishId',ci.dish_id) from carts c join cart_items ci on ci.cart_id=c.id left join family_menu_items fmi on fmi.family_id=c.family_id and fmi.dish_id=ci.dish_id and fmi.enabled=1 left join dishes d on d.id=ci.dish_id and d.status='active' where c.status='active' and (fmi.dish_id is null or d.id is null) union all select 'CART_INACTIVE_FAMILY','CART',c.id,json_object('cartId',c.id,'familyId',c.family_id) from carts c left join families f on f.id=c.family_id and f.status='active' where c.status='active' and f.id is null union all select 'WALLET_NEGATIVE_AMOUNT','USER',mw.user_id, json_object('userId',mw.user_id,'available',mw.balance_amount,'frozen',mw.frozen_amount) from member_wallets mw where mw.balance_amount<0 or mw.frozen_amount<0 union all select 'WALLET_FROZEN_UNMATCHED','USER',mw.user_id, json_object('userId',mw.user_id,'walletFrozen',mw.frozen_amount,'orderFrozen',coalesce(ch.frozen,0)) from member_wallets mw left join ( select omc.user_id,sum(omc.frozen_amount) frozen from order_member_charges omc join orders o on o.id=omc.order_id where lower(o.status) not in ('completed','cancelled') group by omc.user_id ) ch on ch.user_id=mw.user_id where mw.frozen_amount<>coalesce(ch.frozen,0) union all select 'WALLET_PRECISION_INVALID','USER',mw.user_id, json_object('userId',mw.user_id,'available',mw.balance_amount,'frozen',mw.frozen_amount) from member_wallets mw where mw.balance_amount<>round(mw.balance_amount,2) or mw.frozen_amount<>round(mw.frozen_amount,2) union all select 'WALLET_AMOUNT_OVERFLOW','FAMILY',fur.family_id, json_object('familyId',fur.family_id,'available',sum(mw.balance_amount),'frozen',sum(mw.frozen_amount)) from family_user_relations fur join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id=fur.user_id where fur.status='ACTIVE' group by fur.family_id having sum(mw.balance_amount)>9999999999999999.99 or sum(mw.frozen_amount)>9999999999999999.99 union all select 'CART_USER_MISSING','CART',c.id,json_object('cartId',c.id,'userId',c.user_id) from carts c left join users u on u.id=c.user_id where c.status='active' and (c.user_id is null or u.id is null) union all select 'CART_USER_NOT_FAMILY_MEMBER','CART',c.id,json_object('cartId',c.id,'userId',c.user_id) from carts c left join family_user_relations fur on fur.family_id=c.family_id and fur.user_id=c.user_id and fur.status='ACTIVE' where c.status='active' and fur.user_id is null union all select 'CART_QUANTITY_INVALID','CART_ITEM',ci.id,json_object('cartId',c.id,'quantity',ci.quantity) from carts c join cart_items ci on ci.cart_id=c.id where c.status='active' and ci.quantity<=0 union all select 'ORDER_FROZEN_UNMAPPED','ORDER',o.id,json_object('orderId',o.id,'frozen',sum(omc.frozen_amount)) from orders o join order_member_charges omc on omc.order_id=o.id left join family_user_relations fur on fur.family_id=o.family_id and fur.user_id=omc.user_id and fur.status='ACTIVE' where lower(o.status) not in ('completed','cancelled','closed','refunded') and omc.frozen_amount>0 group by o.id having count(fur.user_id)<>count(*) union all select 'FAMILY_WALLET_PREEXISTING','FAMILY',fw.family_id, json_object('familyId',fw.family_id,'available',fw.available_amount,'frozen',fw.frozen_amount) from family_wallets fw where fw.available_amount<>0 or fw.frozen_amount<>0 ) anomalies

insert into family_wallet_migration_anomalies(batch_id,anomaly_type,source_type,source_id,detail_json,resolved) select #{batchId},report_type,source_type,source_id,detail_json,1 from ( select 'CART_REMARK_CONFLICT' report_type,'FAMILY' source_type,c.family_id source_id, json_object('familyId',c.family_id,'distinctRemarks',count(distinct trim(c.remark))) detail_json from carts c where c.status='active' and c.remark is not null and trim(c.remark)<>'' group by c.family_id having count(distinct trim(c.remark))>1 union all select 'ITEM_REMARK_CONFLICT','USER',c.user_id, json_object('familyId',c.family_id,'userId',c.user_id,'dishId',ci.dish_id, 'distinctRemarks',count(distinct trim(ci.item_remark))) from carts c join cart_items ci on ci.cart_id=c.id where c.status='active' and ci.item_remark is not null and trim(ci.item_remark)<>'' group by c.family_id,c.user_id,ci.dish_id having count(distinct trim(ci.item_remark))>1 ) reports
mapper.select: select count(*) from family_wallet_migration_anomalies where batch_id=#{batchId} and resolved=0
mapper.update: update family_wallet_migration_batches set phase='PRECHECK', status=case when #{epoch} is null then 'PREFLIGHT' else 'BARRIER_PREFLIGHT' end, drain_epoch=coalesce(#{epoch},drain_epoch) where id=#{batchId}
mapper.select: select id from families where status='active' order by id

select mw.user_id as userId,mw.balance_amount as availableAmount,mw.frozen_amount as frozenAmount from family_user_relations fur join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id=fur.user_id where fur.family_id=#{familyId} and fur.status='ACTIVE' order by mw.user_id for update
mapper.update: update family_wallets set available_amount=available_amount+#{available},frozen_amount=frozen_amount+#{frozen},version=version+1 where family_id=#{familyId}
update member_wallets set balance_amount=0,frozen_amount=0 where user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into family_wallet_ledgers(family_id,operator_user_id,scope_key,business_type,business_key,amount, available_before,available_after,frozen_before,frozen_after,remark) select #{familyId},#{userId},concat('family:',#{familyId}),'MIGRATION',concat(#{batchId},':',#{userId}), #{available}+#{frozen},available_amount-#{available},available_amount, frozen_amount-#{frozen},frozen_amount,concat('batch:',#{batchId}) from family_wallets where family_id=#{familyId}

insert ignore into family_wallet_order_holds(order_id,family_id,initial_amount,additional_frozen_amount, remaining_frozen_amount,captured_amount,released_amount,refunded_amount,status) select o.id,o.family_id,coalesce(sum(omc.frozen_amount),0),0,coalesce(sum(omc.frozen_amount),0),0,0,0,'MIGRATED' from orders o join order_member_charges omc on omc.order_id=o.id where o.family_id=#{familyId} and lower(o.status) not in ('completed','cancelled','closed','refunded') group by o.id,o.family_id having coalesce(sum(omc.frozen_amount),0)>0
mapper.select: select c.id,c.user_id as userId,c.remark,c.updated_at as updatedAt, case when u.id is null then 0 else 1 end as userExists, case when fur.user_id is null then 0 else 1 end as activeMember from carts c left join users u on u.id=c.user_id left join family_user_relations fur on fur.family_id=c.family_id and fur.user_id=c.user_id and fur.status='ACTIVE' where c.family_id=#{familyId} and c.status='active' order by c.updated_at,c.id for update

select ci.id,ci.dish_id as dishId,ci.quantity,ci.item_remark as itemRemark,ci.updated_at as updatedAt, d.name as dishName,coalesce(fmi.final_price,d.base_price) as currentPrice, case when d.id is not null and d.status='active' then 1 else 0 end as dishActive, case when fmi.dish_id is not null and fmi.enabled=1 then 1 else 0 end as menuEnabled from cart_items ci join carts c on c.id=ci.cart_id left join dishes d on d.id=ci.dish_id left join family_menu_items fmi on fmi.family_id=c.family_id and fmi.dish_id=ci.dish_id where ci.cart_id=#{cartId} order by ci.updated_at,ci.id
select id from cart_items where cart_id=#{cartId} and dish_id=#{dishId}
mapper.insert: insert into cart_item_selections(cart_item_id,user_id,quantity,item_remark) values(#{itemId},#{userId},#{quantity},#{remark}) on duplicate key update quantity=quantity+values(quantity), item_remark=case when values(item_remark) is not null and trim(values(item_remark))<>'' then values(item_remark) else item_remark end
mapper.update: update carts set status='migrated' where id=#{cartId} and status='active'
update family_wallet_migration_batches set phase='EXECUTE',status='EXECUTED' where id=#{batchId} and drain_epoch=#{epoch} and status in ('BARRIER_PREFLIGHT','EXECUTING')
mapper.select: select (select coalesce(sum(source_available_amount),0) from family_wallet_migration_sources where batch_id=#{batchId}) sourceAvailable, (select coalesce(sum(source_frozen_amount),0) from family_wallet_migration_sources where batch_id=#{batchId}) sourceFrozen, (select coalesce(sum(fw.available_amount),0) from family_wallets fw where fw.family_id in (select distinct family_id from family_wallet_migration_sources where batch_id=#{batchId})) targetAvailable, (select coalesce(sum(fw.frozen_amount),0) from family_wallets fw where fw.family_id in (select distinct family_id from family_wallet_migration_sources where batch_id=#{batchId})) targetFrozen, (select count(*) from family_wallet_migration_sources s join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id=s.source_user_id where s.batch_id=#{batchId} and (mw.balance_amount<>0 or mw.frozen_amount<>0)) nonzeroSources, (select count(*) from cart_items ci join carts c on c.id=ci.cart_id and c.status='active' join family_wallet_migration_families mf on mf.batch_id=#{batchId} and mf.family_id=c.family_id where ci.quantity<=0 or ci.quantity <> coalesce((select sum(cis.quantity) from cart_item_selections cis where cis.cart_item_id=ci.id and cis.quantity>0),0)) badSelections

select count(*) from family_wallet_order_holds h where exists(select 1 from family_wallet_migration_sources s where s.batch_id=#{batchId} and s.family_id=h.family_id) and (h.initial_amount+h.additional_frozen_amount<> h.remaining_frozen_amount+h.captured_amount+h.released_amount or h.initial_amount<0 or h.additional_frozen_amount<0 or h.remaining_frozen_amount<0 or h.captured_amount<0 or h.released_amount<0 or h.refunded_amount<0 or h.refunded_amount>h.captured_amount)
select count(*) from information_schema.statistics where table_schema=database() and table_name='carts' and index_name=#{indexName}
mapper.update: update family_wallet_cutover_state set state='FAMILY_READY',maintenance_enabled=0,cutover_epoch=cutover_epoch+1 where scope_key='GLOBAL' and active_batch_id=#{batchId} and drain_epoch=#{epoch} and state='DRAINED' and maintenance_enabled=1
update family_wallet_migration_batches set phase='FINALIZE',status='FINALIZED',completed_at=now() where id=#{batchId} and status='VERIFIED'
mapper.insert: insert into application_instance_leases(instance_id,build_version,lease_owner,heartbeat_at,lease_expires_at) values(#{instanceId},#{build},#{owner},now(),date_add(now(),interval #{seconds} second)) on duplicate key update build_version=values(build_version),lease_owner=values(lease_owner),heartbeat_at=values(heartbeat_at),lease_expires_at=values(lease_expires_at)

insert into family_wallet_migration_runner_lease(scope_key,owner_token,batch_id,drain_epoch,mode,lease_expires_at) values('GLOBAL',#{ownerToken},#{batchId},#{epoch},#{mode},date_add(now(),interval #{seconds} second)) on duplicate key update owner_token=if(lease_expires_at<=now(),values(owner_token),owner_token), batch_id=if(lease_expires_at<=now(),values(batch_id),batch_id), drain_epoch=if(lease_expires_at<=now(),values(drain_epoch),drain_epoch), mode=if(lease_expires_at<=now(),values(mode),mode), lease_expires_at=if(lease_expires_at<=now(),values(lease_expires_at),lease_expires_at)
mapper.select: select owner_token as ownerToken,batch_id as batchId,drain_epoch as drainEpoch,mode,lease_expires_at as leaseExpiresAt from family_wallet_migration_runner_lease where scope_key='GLOBAL' and owner_token=#{ownerToken} and batch_id=#{batchId} and drain_epoch=#{epoch} and lease_expires_at > now() for update
mapper.delete: delete from family_wallet_migration_runner_lease where scope_key='GLOBAL' and owner_token=#{ownerToken}
mapper.select: select count(*) from family_wallet_cutover_state where scope_key='GLOBAL' and maintenance_enabled=1
mapper.insert: insert ignore into family_wallet_migration_families(batch_id,family_id,status) select #{batchId},id,'PENDING' from families where status='active'
mapper.delete: delete mf from family_wallet_migration_families mf left join families f on f.id=mf.family_id and f.status='active' where mf.batch_id=#{batchId} and mf.status='PENDING' and f.id is null
mapper.select: select family_id from family_wallet_migration_families where batch_id=#{batchId} and status='PENDING' order by family_id
select family_id from family_wallet_migration_families where batch_id=#{batchId} order by family_id
select family_id as familyId,status from family_wallet_migration_families where batch_id=#{batchId} and family_id=#{familyId} for update
mapper.update: update family_wallet_migration_families set status='MIGRATED' where batch_id=#{batchId} and family_id=#{familyId} and status='PENDING'
mapper.select: select count(*) from family_wallet_migration_families where batch_id=#{batchId} and status<>'MIGRATED'

select count(*) from member_wallets mw join family_user_relations fur on fur.user_id=mw.user_id and fur.status='ACTIVE' join family_wallet_migration_families mf on mf.batch_id=#{batchId} and mf.family_id=fur.family_id where mw.balance_amount<>0 or mw.frozen_amount<>0

select count(*) from ( select o.id from orders o join family_wallet_migration_families mf on mf.batch_id=#{batchId} and mf.family_id=o.family_id join order_member_charges omc on omc.order_id=o.id left join family_wallet_order_holds h on h.order_id=o.id where lower(o.status) not in ('completed','cancelled','closed','refunded') group by o.id having sum(omc.frozen_amount)>0 and (count(distinct h.id)<>1 or max(h.initial_amount)<>sum(omc.frozen_amount) or max(h.remaining_frozen_amount)<>sum(omc.frozen_amount)) ) missing_holds

select (select case when coalesce(sum(s.source_available_amount),0)<>coalesce(max(fw.available_amount),0) or coalesce(sum(s.source_frozen_amount),0)<>coalesce(max(fw.frozen_amount),0) then 1 else 0 end from family_wallet_migration_sources s left join family_wallets fw on fw.family_id=#{familyId} where s.batch_id=#{batchId} and s.family_id=#{familyId}) + (select count(*) from family_wallet_migration_sources s join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id=s.source_user_id where s.batch_id=#{batchId} and s.family_id=#{familyId} and (mw.balance_amount<>0 or mw.frozen_amount<>0)) + (select count(*) from family_wallet_order_holds h where h.family_id=#{familyId} and (h.initial_amount+h.additional_frozen_amount<>h.remaining_frozen_amount+h.captured_amount+h.released_amount or h.refunded_amount>h.captured_amount)) + (select count(*) from cart_items ci join carts c on c.id=ci.cart_id where c.family_id=#{familyId} and c.status='active' and (ci.quantity<=0 or ci.quantity<>coalesce((select sum(cis.quantity) from cart_item_selections cis where cis.cart_item_id=ci.id and cis.quantity>0),0)))
select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema=database() and table_name='carts' and column_name=#{columnName}

select case when count(*)=1 and max(non_unique)=0 and max(seq_in_index)=1 and max(column_name)=#{columnName} then 1 else 0 end from information_schema.statistics where table_schema=database() and table_name='carts' and index_name=#{indexName}
mapper.update: alter table carts drop index uk_carts_active_cart
alter table carts drop column active_cart_key
alter table carts add column active_family_id bigint generated always as (case when status='active' then family_id else null end) stored
alter table carts add unique key uk_carts_active_family(active_family_id)
